verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a native bulk-edit capability, such as updating, archiving or retargeting many flags at once. Bulk work is only implied: the official CLI, API access tokens and the MCP server would let an AI-native user script batch changes, and segments let one rule apply to many contexts at once. Missing for 10: documented native bulk actions across flags or environments, explicit batch API endpoints, CLI or MCP bulk commands, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
